predators_memory.name: Predator's Memory
predators_memory.desc: Know the enemy's first state each battle.

pattern_recognition.name: Pattern Recognition
pattern_recognition.desc: After 2 observes a battle, Calm is pierced.

stalk.name: Stalk
stalk.desc: Your first Observe each battle, if unhit, grants +1 Dominance.

hunters_patience.name: Hunter's Patience
hunters_patience.desc: If your first attack is after an Observe it's cost is 0.

perfect_read.name: Perfect Read
perfect_read.desc: Unguarded attacks made right after an Observe deal +1.

watchful_silence.name: Watchful Silence
watchful_silence.desc: Breath gained past max is stored as bonus damage on your next attack (capped at +3).

ambush.name: Ambush
ambush.desc: Deal +1 on the first attack each battle.

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.desc: While at +3 Dominance or higher, attacks deal +1.

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.desc: Undefended hits vs enemies at half HP or below deal +1.

iron_nerves.name: Iron Nerves
iron_nerves.desc: Fully blocking an attack restores 1 Breath.

unyielding.name: Unyielding
unyielding.desc: Mitigate damage and your attack NEXT turn deals +1.

evasive_reflexes.name: Evasive Reflexes
evasive_reflexes.desc: Fully blocking makes the enemy lose 1 Breath.

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.desc: Gain 1 Breath each turn while below half HP.

predators_hunger.name: Predator's Hunger
predators_hunger.desc: Heal +1 extra HP after a kill.
